visual_name: Day in the life, part seventeen: two minutes (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js sewing room, box-built character, a paper script that shortens with each cut, a stopwatch, first draft / cutting stack / generated script pages, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.3 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a thirty second brief, a script that reads at two minutes, scissors through the intro, the middle and the ending until it fits, makes no sense and never mentions the product; then YourBrand's script generator: pick thirty seconds and get a hook, beats, the product moment and a CTA sized to fit, plus three more hooks. Her first draft is still running.
